typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCatalystAgingLiveTradesCurrent_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		AGE as integer,
		counterparty as string,
		cusip as string,
		isParentChild as string,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME as string,
		DESK_NAME as string,
		TicketNumber as string,
		EntryDate as string,
		TradeDate as string,
		SettleDate as string,
		TicketTypeCode as string,
		Entered_By as string,
		TraderName as string,
		Approved_By as string,
		PositionGroupDesc as string,
		TradeStatusString as string,
		Sales as string,
		Par as string,
		TradePrice as string,
		TotalCash as string,
		PreviousTicketNumber as string,
		Desk_ManagerName as string,
		LoadDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> EXECspselCatalystPOQAgingLiveTrade
EXECspselCatalystPOQAgingLiveTrade derive({Copy of TRADING_UNIT_NAME} = TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		{Copy of DESK_NAME} = DESK_NAME,
		{Copy of TradeDate} = toDate(TradeDate, "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of Desk_ManagerName} = Desk_ManagerName,
		{Copy of EntryDate} = toDate(EntryDate, "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of SettleDate} = toDate(SettleDate, "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Par as string,
		LoadDate as string,
		TraderName as string,
		cusip as string,
		desk_managerName as string,
		Entered_By as string,
		Approved_By as string,
		TradePrice as string,
		TradeStatusString as string,
		isParentChild as string,
		DESK_NAME as string,
		PositionGroupDesc as string,
		PreviousTicketNumber as string,
		Sales as string,
		TicketNumber as string,
		TotalCash as string,
		EntryDate as string,
		counterparty as string,
		TradeDate as string,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME as string,
		SettleDate as string,
		AGE as string,
		TicketTypeCode as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Par,
		LoadDate,
		TraderName,
		cusip,
		desk_managerName = {Copy of Desk_ManagerName},
		Entered_By,
		Approved_By,
		TradePrice,
		TradeStatusString,
		isParentChild,
		DESK_NAME = {Copy of DESK_NAME},
		PositionGroupDesc,
		PreviousTicketNumber,
		Sales,
		TicketNumber,
		TotalCash,
		EntryDate = {Copy of EntryDate},
		counterparty,
		TradeDate = {Copy of TradeDate},
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME = {Copy of TRADING_UNIT_NAME},
		SettleDate = {Copy of SettleDate},
		AGE,
		TicketTypeCode),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCatalystAgingLiveTradesCurrent_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCatalystAgingLiveTradesCurrent
